name: scientific-figure-builder-reviewer
description: Build editable scientific figures from references and perform fail-closed final reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Editable scientific figure building and final audit
interface.longDescription: A two-skill toolkit for staged reconstruction of scientific figures as editable PowerPoint objects and an explicit, read-only final audit against the source.
defaultPrompt: Use $scientific-figure-builder to rebuild this figure in PowerPoint.
Use $scientific-figure-reviewer to audit this PPT against its reference.
